claims.subject: application_fees
claims.statement: The department does not charge applicants any fee to apply, to be assessed or to be paid.
claims.quote: The department does not charge applicants any fee to apply, to be assessed or to be paid.

claims.subject: payment_account
claims.statement: All sampled payments were made by electronic funds transfer to an account in the applicant's own name.
claims.scope: sampled Riverbend Flood Recovery Grant payments, 1 April to 31 May 2026
claims.quote: All sampled payments were made by electronic funds transfer to an account in the applicant's own name, and no payment was made to a third party.

claims.subject: grant_amounts
claims.statement: Each sampled payment matched an approved tier: $2,000 for contents only, $5,000 for minor structural repairs, $10,000 for major structural repairs.
claims.scope: Riverbend Flood Recovery Grant approved applications
claims.quote: Each sampled payment matched an approved tier, being $2,000 where only contents were lost, $5,000 for minor structural repairs or $10,000 for major structural repairs.

claims.subject: payment_account
claims.statement: The department never asks applicants to pay money or to send funds to any account.
claims.quote: Staff should continue to tell callers that the department never asks applicants to pay money or to send funds to any account.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: Management's completion date for accepted audit recommendations is 31 July 2026.
claims.quote: Management has accepted both recommendations, with completion due by 31 July 2026.
